Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle. The piece is still in your bag and the Autumn Sale is still on; both are true today, so a few words from me instead of a banner, while they hold.

Why I'd keep it: the pieces that stay are the ones you pull on without a decision. First cold morning, coat over it, out the door; the same piece the week after, with nothing else changed. What you chose is cut for exactly that.

And for this bag, 15% on top of the 45% Autumn Sale. Your code:

{% coupon_code 'CHECKOUT15' %}

Warmly,
Claire
Nora Lanelle
